I bought these specifically for my Liatris Gay Feathers to attempt to control their Cleome attitude. As the season progressed they were either contortion experts or lying prostrate in the garden dirt, fighting all attempts to raise them upright. This beautiful little item encourages them to stand tall. They still fight, bowing in unpleasant positions, but with a little rain they relax and look so much more comfortable.
